offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures highly engineered precision bearings, mechanical components, gearing, hydraulics and related assemblies. Sells to aerospace and defense primes, industrial OEMs and distributors, made in its own plants.

primary_products.value: plain bearings; roller bearings; ball bearings; gearing and gearboxes; hydraulic components; engineered fasteners and locking components

customer_segment.value: B2B: aerospace and defense OEMs, industrial equipment manufacturers, distributors; B2G: U.S. defense agencies via direct and prime contractor programs

end_markets.value: aerospace; defense; industrial machinery; semiconductor equipment; energy; marine

revenue_model.value: product sales: engineered bearings and components sold to OEMs and distributors

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: manufactures precision bearings and components from purchased steel and materials, sold to OEMs and distributors

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia and other international markets, with plants in North America and Europe

specialization.value: related lines: plain bearings, roller bearings, ball bearings, engineered components and gearing for aerospace and industrial uses

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: OEMs and aerospace/defense primes; distributors / dealers: industrial bearing distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: aerospace quality certifications (FAA, AS9100), defense export controls (ITAR) and procurement rules
